text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City trains with fierce passion for 
the Nihon Derby. She is in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, hearing that Tamamo Cross was 
injured, her Trainer goes to check on her. 
Her running looked pained, yet her 
extraordinary obsession with victory 
remained unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross refused to lose to Gold City, 
who had begun earning acclaim at the 
Satsuki Sho. Burning with fighting spirit, 
she vowed to overpower all adversity with 
her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City was overwhelmed by that fierce 
spirit. She fired herself up once more for 
the Derby.
